metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IQODOL crystallizes in the tetragonal crystal system with space group P 4/n m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C64 H114 Eu8 N64 Ni24 O58 S32 6+,6(Br1 1-),C1 H4 O1,3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu2 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni7 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni5 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni6 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni8 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni9 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni10 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni11 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni12 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni13 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni14 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni15 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni16 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni17 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni18 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni19 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ni20 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni21 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni22 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni23 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Ni24 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni25 (Ni) has 3 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu9 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 68 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.966-4.360 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 84.71-144.91°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ni24Eu8(OH)18(mmt)16(N3)8(NO3)8(CH3O)16]·6Br·4CH3OH·3H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 18 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 8 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
